integrity: Exact symbolic stage/moment computations verified from embedded standalone script; stochastic weak convergence relies on an explicit analytic martingale-limit proof. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional smooth autonomous ODEs; independent U[1/2,1] stages; small h and fixed finite T. Error interpolation is nodal; cancellation on reciprocal-affine intervals excludes poles. Potential unindexed prior distributional result and intermittent full-text access remain limitations.
title: Gaussian fluctuation law and sharp \(h^{5/2}\) error barrier for randomized two-stage SDIRK
